thread:
Eli (Sales): Moneta wants a 5-week POC for their customer-support summarization flow. Requirements: VPC-only, customer-managed KMS/HSM, no external logs, soft start in 2 weeks. They estimate 8k DAU, ~4 calls/user/day, avg 95 tokens/request, occasional promo blasts. Need sizing + cost band + SOW success criteria.
Tara (SE): Quick calc: 8k * 4 * 95 = 3,040,000 tokens/day -> ~92M tokens/month. For 5 weeks ~15.2M? wait: 3.04M/day * 35 = 106.4M tokens total.
Maya (Infra): Baseline throughput: assume steady 150 RPS; 150*95=14,250 tok/s. Promo blasts: spikes to 1,200 RPS for 2-3 mins -> 114k tok/s.
Omar (SRE): Rough GPU throughput (model-dependent): mid GPU ~3k tok/s, large GPU ~7k tok/s. Baseline 14.25k tok/s => ~5 mid GPUs or 2 large GPUs. Burst 114k tok/s => ~38 mid GPUs or ~16 large GPUs (ephemeral).
Tara (SE): Cost mitigations: prefix caching of common templates, pre-filter classifier to drop/refuse trivial prompts, 10-25% sampling at start. Also smaller model variant for lower-risk flows. For POC recommend: reserve 2 large GPUs (critical path) + autoscale mid-GPU spot pool for bursts + hosted overflow as last resort.
Priya (Security): Confirm KMS/HSM required and customer wants key rotation policy + audit events into their S3 for 90 days. Network peering + firewall rules needed. Questionnaire turnaround: 72 hours.
Maya (Infra): Cost sketch (cloud-equivalent): large GPU $40/hr, mid GPU $12/hr. Reserve 2 large 12h/day + burst spot mid-GPUs on-demand. For 5 weeks infra ~ $9k-$12k. Platform & token fees estimate ~$3k-$5k depending on negotiated rate and token discounts. Total ballpark ~$12k-$17k.
Eli (Sales): Customer target budget ~14k. This range could work if we emphasize staged sampling.
Omar (SRE): Proposed success criteria for SOW:
1) Latency: p95 < 600ms for staged 25% traffic during week 2.
2) Reliability: e2e error rate < 1.5% across pilot.
3) Quality: >= 91% pass rate on a 180-prompt eval (mix of short summaries, long threads, and privacy edge cases) with 25 manual checks.
4) Cost cap: pilot <= $15k unless customer approves premium tier.
5) Security: VPC peering, CMK/HSM, and audit export validated before full traffic.
Tara (SE): Eval snippet we'll use (canonical prompt):
```
{"prompt":"User message thread: [long conversation omitted] Summarize the key actions and account refs.", "expected":"3 action items: refund txn 321, escalate to ops, confirm identity X"}
```
Omar (SRE): Load test command for staging:
```
heyload --rps 150 --burst-rps 1200 --burst-duration 180 --duration 10m --payload=moneta_prompts.json
```
Priya (Security): I'll draft answers to the questionnaire: KMS access policy, HSM requirements, retention cadence, and minimal audit pipeline.
Presales Bot: allocation_request created: poc-moneta-991 (status: pending_network)
Eli (Sales): Thanks all — I'll package this into a POC proposal (include Plan A: staged sampling + autoscale; Plan B: premium low-latency reserved) and send to Moneta. Target kickoff: 10 business days pending network/KMS approval. :thumbsup:
